brief.summary: Soft, romantic polish: statement knitwear — chunky hand-knits, volume sleeves, folk motifs — over long fluid skirts, or with straight cropped jeans. Tonal ivory, cream and grey head to toe; volume and texture on top, long and fluid below; flats, loafers or pointed pumps, and sunglasses always.
signatures: chunky hand-knit cardigan with volume or balloon sleeves
belted knit cardigan over a flared wool midi skirt
jumper over a lace or embroidered midi skirt
oversized mohair knit over a white slip dress
straight cropped mid-wash jeans with loafers
cream structured top-handle bag, brown leather tote
ballet flats, loafers and pointed pumps
silhouettes: volume on top, long and fluid below
